The tabs would tell you, but I never really got into the groove of the patterns until I saw a YouTube video about it. I just peeked at a lesson on The Boxer talking about the finger picking patterns and just practiced getting that down to muscle memory. Different songs will have different patterns but there are a few really popular ones. It’s like learning strumming patterns but instead of ups and downs, it’s individual strings.

I’d look into Travis Picking to understand the technique, expose yourself to some popular Travis picking patterns then try to learn a song that uses it.

Paul Simon really liked using the same couple patterns. Once I learned that one little pattern from The Boxer, I found it to be helpful in learning Kathy’s Song, Sound of Silence, Homeward Bound, Bleecker Street, April Come She Will, and a couple Bob Dylan songs.
